estadisticas.abrir_texto.texto: What is hardest, who needs help and pairs to help each other

estadisticas.incompleto.texto: This class has a lot of activity: only the latest 100,000 events are analysed.

estadisticas.vacia.texto: No activity yet. Once students join with the class code and start playing, you will see how they are doing here.

estadisticas.trabajar_ayuda.texto: What is most often wrong first time (at least 5 answers).

estadisticas.fallan.texto: {pct} % wrong first time · got it wrong at least once: {n} of {de}

estadisticas.nada_dificil.texto: Nothing stands out: everything is right first time over 70 % of the time. Well done!

estadisticas.sin_respuestas.texto: No answers yet (they come from lessons and «Guess»).

estadisticas.empujon_ayuda.texto: Behind the middle of the class, getting many wrong, or not logged in for days.

estadisticas.adelantados_ayuda.texto: Ahead of most and very accurate: they can explain to others or try harder challenges.

estadisticas.grupos_ayuda.texto: They mix levels so whoever is ahead explains to whoever is behind. Explaining also consolidates learning.

estadisticas.grupos_como.texto: How they are made: students are ranked by progress and accuracy, the list is split in half and the first of each half are paired, then the second… Different levels, but not too far apart to understand each other. Teams are dealt in a snake so every level is present. It is a suggestion: adjust it with what you know about your class.

estadisticas.pocos_para_grupos.texto: At least 2 active students are needed.

estadisticas.diario_ayuda.texto: Last 30 days. Hover for actions and lessons that day.

estadisticas.calor.texto: When it is used: day and hour

estadisticas.calor_ayuda.texto: More colour, more activity. Busiest: {dia} at {hora}:00.

estadisticas.por_tipo.texto: Right first time by question type

estadisticas.por_tipo_ayuda.texto: Worst to best. The top ones are worth reviewing.

estadisticas.unidades_ayuda.texto: How many have finished every lesson in each unit. The middle of the class has completed {mediana} steps of the path.

estadisticas.elementos_ayuda.texto: Each element and how many have done its lesson (more colour, more people).

estadisticas.alumnado_ayuda.texto: Those who need most attention first. Tap an alias to see their details.

estadisticas.nota_privacidad.texto: Statistics are calculated in your browser from what each alias does in the app; nothing else is stored. They are a guide: your judgement comes first.

estadisticas.comparar_ayuda.texto: Students active in the last 7 days, by class.

estadisticas.motivo.poco_avance.texto: {n} steps of the path done; the middle of the class, {mediana}

estadisticas.motivo.adelantado.texto: {n} steps of the path and {pct} % accuracy

estadisticas.idea.dato.texto: Review the element cards: history, uses and fun facts. A quick round of questions out loud works well.

estadisticas.idea.protones.texto: Protons = atomic number (Z). Practise reading it from the periodic table.

estadisticas.idea.electrones.texto: A neutral atom has as many electrons as protons. Stress the word «neutral».

estadisticas.idea.neutrones.texto: Neutrons = mass number (A) − atomic number (Z). Work through several on the board.

estadisticas.idea.simbolo.texto: Symbols starting the same way (C, Ca, Cl, Co, Cu…) get mixed up: a symbol–name matching game helps.

estadisticas.idea.pista.texto: Link each element to its properties and uses: each student presents one element in 1 minute.

estadisticas.idea.formula.texto: Count atoms using subscripts. Build the molecules with the cards on the table, in groups.

estadisticas.idea.objeto.texto: Look for objects in the classroom and the elements they are made of; the «Matter» section has ideas.
